assessment.rationale: The fundamental credit view is moderate and provisional: total leverage is {{FIG:total_leverage_reported}} and net leverage {{FIG:net_leverage_reported}} on reported EBITDA for the twelve months to FY2025, and interest cover is {{FIG:interest_coverage_reported}}, but a single maturity, undisclosed customer concentration, unaudited statements and absent covenant terms keep confidence below High.
assessment.limitation: Unaudited statements, no covenant terms, undisclosed customer concentration and an undisclosed ownership chain

thesis.text: Northbridge Synthetic Group is a low-leverage, cash-generative industrial manufacturer whose credit strength rests on unaudited figures and a single maturity, so the view is a provisional stable thesis pending covenant terms and customer disclosure.

strengths.label: Low reported leverage
strengths.text: Total leverage is {{FIG:total_leverage_reported}} and net leverage is {{FIG:net_leverage_reported}} on reported EBITDA for the twelve months to FY2025.

strengths.label: Cash generation and cover
strengths.text: Interest cover is {{FIG:interest_coverage_reported}} and free cash flow is {{FIG:fcf_to_debt}} of debt, with capital expenditure entirely for maintenance.

strengths.label: No acquisition pressure
strengths.text: No acquisition or disposal occurred in the period, so there is no integration or acquisition-funding pressure on cash flow.

weaknesses.label: Single maturity and no revolver
weaknesses.text: All debt is one senior secured term loan with no revolving facility, so liquidity rests on cash and operating cash flow and refinancing is concentrated at one date.

weaknesses.label: Customer concentration unassessed
weaknesses.text: Customer concentration and the revenue split are not disclosed, so revenue durability cannot be confirmed.
weaknesses.limitation: The largest-customer share and the product-line split are not disclosed, so their effect on revenue durability is unknown

weaknesses.label: Distributions and unaudited reporting
weaknesses.text: Dividends are paid to the sole shareholder every quarter, the funding source is not documented and the statements are unaudited, which weakens confidence in cash available for debt service.

key_findings.text: Leverage is low: total {{FIG:total_leverage_reported}} and net {{FIG:net_leverage_reported}} on reported EBITDA for the twelve months to FY2025, with interest cover of {{FIG:interest_coverage_reported}}.
All debt is a single senior secured term loan maturing on December 31, 2029 with no revolver, which concentrates refinancing risk at one date.
Quarterly dividends to the sole shareholder continue while their funding source and the owners behind the holding company are undisclosed.
Customer concentration, covenant terms and an audit report are missing, so the credit view stays provisional.
